name: Elena Ramirez
bio:
Elena Ramirez discovered her passion for electronics at a young age, tinkering with radios and building her own circuits in her family's workshop in Buenos Aires. She pursued a degree in electrical engineering and quickly found her way into the world of motorsport, drawn to the challenge of pushing technological boundaries under immense pressure. Elena began her career with a smaller racing outfit before joining EVO Racing Team, where she has become a vital asset. 

Elena's approach to electronics engineering is meticulous and innovative. She has a knack for identifying subtle improvements that can lead to significant performance gains on the track. Known for her calm demeanor and ability to troubleshoot complex problems quickly, Elena is highly valued by her team. She is distinctive for her ability to visualize solutions and her unwavering commitment to excellence.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly styled bob with a few strands of silver
physical.description: Elena is of average height with a thoughtful expression and a warm smile.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool in her pocket.
Has a habit of humming quietly when deeply focused.
Insists on organizing electrical components by color and size.
